disposition.note: SCR-44 is in the P3 screen story, not this migration contract. Empty, loading, error and no-access states are screen design content not in the sources. No edit.
Added AC7 in section 7 covering BR1 to BR10 and TC-PLT-E1044-CON-07 in section 16, which covers AC7. Rules are now anchored to a criterion and a test.
Element names, request and answer shapes, MSG-P7-009 text and the login name are in no readable source (checked the story and evidence). They cannot be invented here. No edit.
The rwb-document login name, secret reference and grants are not in any source. Allocating them needs a value the directive does not supply. No edit.
No source gives the rwb_access login name (Template R5.5 DP-02, Architecture v5 slide 41, TSD P4 T1 and T3.1 checked). Naming it would invent a credential identifier. No edit.
BR5 already states the default flyway_schema_history in the own schema. The migration-run record field list is in no source and cannot be stated without inventing it. No edit.
Added AC7 in section 7 (after AC6) for BR1 to BR10, with the test case TC-PLT-E1044-CON-07 in section 16. Proposed test is derived from the section 8 rule text.
